notes: [STABLE, niche] Black-on-black utility with visible hardware — every piece should have straps, zips, or extra pockets. Silhouette: slim top, voluminous articulated pants, tapered at ankle into chunky shoe. The sling/chest bag is the authenticity marker. Mostly menswear in practice.

notes: [STABLE] Beat-up over box-fresh: the fit should look lived in — faded graphic, scuffed shoes, pants fraying at the heel. Tee layered under short-sleeve or flannel open over hoodie. Pants fully cover the shoe topline. Unisex; girls' version adds baby tee up top against the baggy pant.

notes: [STABLE] Tan/brown canvas is the anchor; build tonal earth layers and let hardware details (hammer loop, double knee, brass zips) do the talking. Boxy chore jacket over hoodie is the signature layer stack. Strong menswear default; womenswear version crops the tee and keeps the pant huge.

name: Japanese City Boy
notes: [STABLE] Relaxed-everything but tidy: wide pleated trouser with intentional pooling, boxy shirt buttoned to the top or layered over a tee, sock visible above a low sneaker. No logos, no distressing — the flex is fit and fabric. Best sophisticated-casual menswear lane for Dev.

name: Y2K Revival
notes: [STABLE — verified alive in 2026, revival mode] The non-negotiable is the low-rise waistline plus exposed midriff; hitting the palette (baby pink, silver metallic, sky blue) matters more than any single piece. Pair one maximal piece (rhinestone, metallic) with one plain. Metallics and 2000s activewear are the 2026-specific refresh.

name: Grunge
notes: [STABLE] The formula is deliberate wrongness: slip dress OVER a tee, flannel tied at waist, fishnets under ripped denim. Everything faded or distressed; anything crisp kills it. Menswear = flannel + band tee + ripped denim + boots, hair unstyled.

name: Fairy Grunge
notes: [STABLE, niche but persistent — 'cyber fairy grunge' named a 2026 rotation aesthetic] Earthy greens and mushroom browns in soft ruined textures; the look is built by stacking sheer/knit layers (mesh under cami under cardigan) and adding limb accessories (arm/leg warmers). Distressing reads whimsical not punk.

name: Coquette

dress: satin slip dress with lace trim

notes: [PEAKING — biggest feminine aesthetic of 2026, 15B+ views] One bow minimum, ideally echoed (hair bow + ribbon detail on garment). Palette discipline is strict: pinks/whites/cream with at most one red accent (cherry, lip). Mix sweet with slight sultry — lace slip + cardigan, never full costume. Balletcore is the athletic cousin; route overlap there.

name: Balletcore
notes: [STABLE] Off-duty-dancer logic: soft knits wrapped and tied over body-hugging base layers, palette of blush/cream/black. Leg warmers over flats or flared leggings are the tell. Reads as the wearable daytime version of coquette.

If a user requests it, honor it; don't proactively suggest. Leopard print itself migrated into boho-revival and indie-sleaze styling.

name: Old Money / Quiet Luxury
notes: [STABLE-DOMINANT — one of the two ruling 2026 staples] Fit quality is the whole aesthetic: tailored not tight, colors in a strict neutral band (cream/camel/navy/white), zero visible branding. The knit-over-shoulders drape and tonal dressing (three shades of one neutral) are the authenticity tells. Excellent for Dev: navy blazer + white tee + tailored trouser + loafer is the menswear default.

name: Clean Girl
notes: [STABLE-DOMINANT] Formula: one fitted basic + one relaxed piece (ribbed tank + wide pant, or bodysuit + oversized blazer), max three colors all neutral, gold hoops always. The polish is in coherence — matching sets score high. Cheap fabrics photograph fine in this aesthetic, which makes it the safest fast-fashion default.
